name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: Provides cashless health insurance coverage for poor and vulnerable families.
eligibility: SECC-listed rural and urban poor households.
benefits: Up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for hospitalization.

name: Ayushman Arogya Mandir
description: Provides comprehensive primary healthcare through upgraded Health and Wellness Centres.
benefits: Free consultations, NCD screening, maternal and child healthcare.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Aushadhi Pariyojana
description: Provides affordable generic medicines through Jan Aushadhi Kendras.

name: Mission Indradhanush
description: Universal immunization programme for children and pregnant women.
eligibility: Children below 5 years and pregnant women.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit scheme for pregnant and lactating mothers.

name: POSHAN Abhiyaan
description: National nutrition mission to reduce malnutrition.
eligibility: Pregnant women, lactating mothers, adolescents and children.

name: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS)
description: Provides supplementary nutrition and early childhood care.
eligibility: Children under 6 years and pregnant/lactating women.

name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal Scheme)
description: Provides nutritious meals to school children.
eligibility: Students in government and aided schools.
benefits: Free nutritious meals during school days.

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao
description: Promotes survival, protection and education of the girl child.
benefits: Awareness and support initiatives for girls.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
description: Savings scheme for girl child.
benefits: High-interest savings account for future education and marriage.

name: One Stop Centre Scheme
description: Support services for women affected by violence.

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Income support scheme for farmers.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Crop insurance scheme for farmers.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Provides easy access to agricultural credit.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Provides information about soil nutrient status.
benefits: Improved crop productivity and fertilizer usage.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Provides housing assistance for rural poor families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Affordable housing scheme for urban families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Universal banking access scheme.
benefits: Zero-balance account, RuPay card and insurance.

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Pension scheme for unorganized sector workers.

name: Swachh Bharat Mission
description: National cleanliness and sanitation initiative.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission
description: Provides tap water connections to rural households.

name: Unique Disability ID (UDID)
description: Single national disability identity system.
benefits: Unified disability certificate and easier access to schemes.

name: ADIP Scheme
description: Provides assistive devices to persons with disabilities.

name: PM Ujjwala Yojana
description: Provides LPG connections to poor households.
benefits: Free LPG connection and financial support.
